Kimberly — great to meet you earlier. Appreciate the clear MAP draft. A few notes from procurement / finance perspective:

- Procurement timing: FY26 budget approvals wrap the first week of July for our BU. That means the earliest Procurement can issue a signed contract is the week of 2026-08-02. Realistically, plan for a signature target of 2026-08-05 to allow internal PO and legal routing.

- Security ask: Procurement will require our SOC2 Type II report + confirmation of data retention and access controls. Please include the SOC2 report and a short security FAQ in the SOW appendix.

- Legal: they typically take 2–3 weeks for initial redlines but will escalate for strategic vendors. We will pull Legal in once Procurement signals budget availability.

- Contacts: procurement@acmeindustrial.com (cc-ed) is the correct intake address. If you can copy me and the BU lead (Irene.Hernandez@acmeindustrial.com) on the first redline delivery that will help visibility.

Given this, we cannot meet the 2026-07-21 procurement cutoff — please revise the MAP to reflect the August 5 signature target and highlight dependencies required to keep the pilot start in mid-August.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Digital Operations | AcmeIndustrial

Kimberly — quick read and next steps from Legal: 

- Compressed review: yes, Legal can fast-track a 2-week initial review if Commercial confirms core economics (list price, term length, SOW scope). Please get me the target term sheet; I need the list of non-negotiables up front.

- SOC2: we can provide our 2025 SOC2 Type II report and a one-page security FAQ for the SOW appendix. I'll attach both to the redline packet. That should satisfy Procurement's initial ask.

- Clauses to flag now (likely negotiation points): data residency request (if Acme requests EU-only, that's material), indemnity cap and limitation of liability language, and the data retention/destruction window. If Acme asks for vendor audit rights beyond SOC2, that will add 3–4 weeks.

Marcus — if the onboarding plan requires VPC peering and pre-prod data extracts, we need to confirm timelines for network access requests and whether Acme's infra team will provide a temporary test dataset. If not, the pilot kickoff could slip 1–2 weeks.

I will prepare an annotated redline plan and share it to procurement once we have the term sheet.

— Rishi
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
